moments.text: Guess first. Your staging admin panel only accepts connections from your home IP address. You're on café Wi-Fi. How do you get in, without touching the allowlist?

frame.headline:
The allowlist says
home IP only
frame.sub: You're at a café. How do you get in?

moments.say: Tailscale only carries traffic between your own devices. A request to the admin panel still leaves through the café's network, from the café's address, and is refused.
An exit node is a device on your tailnet that carries all your public internet traffic. A subnet router reaches one private network; an exit node reaches everything else. Make the dev box one.
Now the request travels encrypted to the dev box, and leaves from your home network. The panel sees your home address, and lets you in.
Three steps. On the dev box, turn on I P forwarding, as for a subnet router, then offer it: tailscale set, dash dash advertise exit node.
moments.text: Three steps. On the dev box, turn on IP forwarding, as for a subnet router, then offer it: `tailscale set --advertise-exit-node`.

lines.text: # admin console > Machines > Edit exit node > Use as exit node

moments.say: Then approve it: in the admin console, on the Machines page, edit exit node, then use as exit node.
moments.text: Then approve it: in the admin console, on the Machines page, “Edit exit node”, then “Use as exit node”.

moments.say: On your laptop, a what's my I P service shows the café's address. Choose the exit node: dash dash exit node equals dev box.
moments.text: On your laptop, a what's-my-IP service shows the café's address. Choose the exit node: --exit-node=dev-box.

moments.say: One caveat: while it's on, devices on the café's own network are out of reach, unless you add dash dash exit node allow LAN access.
moments.text: One caveat: while it's on, devices on the café's own network are out of reach, unless you add --exit-node-allow-lan-access.

moments.say: To stop, set exit node to nothing.
Remember: Tailscale normally carries only tailnet traffic. Choose an exit node, and everything else goes through it.
